notes.title: New Version Update! Thanks for Your Feedback!
notes.notes:
Hello to all players of No Return!

We are the development team behind No Return.
 We have received all your feedback and are working to further optimize and resolve the issues within our game. We appreciate your patience and understanding! Here are the issues that have been fixed in this update:

[list]
[*] Further reduced the flashing effects in some scenes.
[/list][list]
[*] Increased the brightness in certain scenes.
[/list][list]
[*] Fixed the bug where trolleys in the car scene could bypass barriers and get stuck in obstacles.
[/list][list]
[*] Fixed the bug where talismans couldn't be selected.
[/list]
We will continue to address and fix more bugs and issues that exist in the game. Thank you all for your support!

notes.title: Bug Fix Update!
notes.notes:
Dear all,

BlameTech here, the dev team for "No Return".

First off, thank you for playing our game...even though the experience had been negative so far. 
We've received your feedback regarding the bugs in the game and the issues with overly bright or dark scenes. We're made note of it and immediately made the following changes:

[list]
[*] Black screen bug during chase sequences
[*] Game freeze bug when opening the refrigerator before the chase sequence in level 7
[*] Game freeze bug when unable to pick up the kitchen knife after the car door closes in level 7
[*] Game freeze bug when getting stuck inside the bathroom in level 6
[/list]

We continue to keep fixing bugs and issues related to overly bright and dark scenes. We also hope that the critical issues are resolved. Please feel free to directly let us know on [url=https://discord.gg/ANd9KscwNu]Discord[/url] if you encounter issues.

Sincerely,
BlameTech

notes.title: Game Patch No.1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We wanted to express our heartfelt thanks for your continued support and feedback. As we did work on the game for a long time, we deeply value each player's input and have released a new update tonight to enhance your experience based on the game reviews so far.

In this update, we have made the following adjustments:

[olist]
[*] Removed the debug mode from the game to ensure a smoother and more immersive experience.

[*] Significantly reduced light flickering and red light effects, and increased the overall brightness. We hope these changes will improve your gameplay experience.
[/olist]

We are committed to providing you with the best possible experience, and we appreciate your understanding and support. Please feel free to share any further suggestions or feedback with us.

Thank you all!
Blametech team

Feel free to chat with us/give immediate feedback to the team on [url=https://discord.gg/ANd9KscwNu]Discord[/url]
